name: Which type of tile works best for bathroom floors and shower walls?

mainEntity.name: Which type of tile works best for bathroom floors and shower walls?

acceptedAnswer.text: Porcelain and ceramic are the most practical choices for bathroom floors and wet areas due to their water resistance, durability, and easy maintenance. Porcelain absorbs less than 0.5% moisture, making it especially suitable for walk-in showers and heavy splash zones. Natural stone such as marble or travertine delivers an upscale look, but it requires regular sealing and specialized cleaners to prevent stains and moisture penetration. Glass tiles work well for decorative shower accents or backsplashes, though they are prone to cracking under foot traffic. Your selection depends on whether you prioritize long-term slip resistance and low maintenance over the distinct look and routine upkeep of natural stone.
acceptedAnswer.description: Porcelain and ceramic are best for bathroom floors and showers due to their moisture resistance and durability. Natural stone looks elegant but requires regular sealing.
